name: Getariako Txakolina

known.via: English Wikipedia "Getariako Txakolina" (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

terms: Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A Basque Country appellation around the fishing towns of Getaria and Zarautz on the Bay of Biscay, in Gipuzkoa. It makes txakoli, a white wine that can be naturally sparkling and is poured from a height. Hondarrabi Zuri is among its allowed grapes.
